# Simulators & Environments

> Physics simulators, rendering stacks and environment platforms for building and testing harnesses.  
> Layer: L6 · 44 entries · [overview](../README.md#sim) · [survey](../SURVEY.md)

**Legend:** 🟢 open · 🟡 partial · 🔵 api · ⚪ closed. Hover a name for the full paper title. Newest first within each year.

**2026**

- 🟢 [**LiteReality-Agent**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01863 "LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction") · 2026-10 — Treats real-to-sim scene reconstruction as coding: a coding agent gathers evidence from RGB-D scans with specialised tools and edits an executable Room.py inside an observe-edit-verify harness, producing articulated, simulation-ready digital twins. [code](https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent) · [project](https://litereality.github.io/agent/)
- ⚪ [**DeformSmith**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.18620 "DeformSmith: Physics Harness-Guided Hierarchical Generation of Deformable Assets for Robot Manipulation") · 2026-09 — Generates simulation-ready deformable assets from text or an image through hierarchical agentic construction around a shared physics harness that builds, tests and refines geometry, material behaviour and robot interaction, closing the loop with manipulation feedback. _Note: Code repository announced but not yet released (checked 2026-09-30)._ [project](https://can-lee.github.io/deformsmith-web/)
- ⚪ [**Lingjing**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08045 "Lingjing: A Simulation Testbed for Multi-Agent Embodied Tasks in Open-Ended Cities") · 2026-08 · Aerospace Information Research Institute (CAS), Shanghai Jiao Tong University — City-scale testbed for heterogeneous multi-agent embodied tasks (UAVs, ground robots, vehicles) that rebuilds cities from geographic data, syncs several physics engines, offers a Gym-like API for ReAct agents with configurable communication, and logs replays for diagnosis. _Note: First-party evaluation of twelve VLMs on nine urban tasks; code release not verified._
- 🟢 [**SIMPLE**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08278 "SIMPLE: Simulation-Based Policy Learning and Evaluation for Humanoid Loco-manipulation") · 2026-06 — Humanoid loco-manipulation testbed coupling MuJoCo contact dynamics with Isaac Sim rendering: 60 whole-body tasks, 50 indoor scenes, 1,000+ assets, motion-planning and VR-teleop data pipelines, and benchmarks of imitation, VLA and world-action models. _Note: First-party results report strong sim-real correlation and zero-shot transfer to physical humanoids._ [code](https://github.com/physical-superintelligence-lab/SIMPLE) · [project](https://psi-lab.ai/SIMPLE)
- 🟢 [**Kamino**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16536 "Kamino: GPU-based Massively Parallel Simulation of Multi-Body Systems with Challenging Topologies") · 2026-03 · Disney Research, NVIDIA — GPU physics solver in NVIDIA Warp, integrated into Newton, that natively handles kinematic loops and batched heterogeneous robots by solving constrained multibody dynamics as a nonlinear complementarity problem; trains a biped with six nested loops in 4,096 envs. _Note: Ships inside the Newton repo (Kamino examples under newton/examples/kamino)._ [code](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton)
- 🟢 [**SceneSmith**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09153 "SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes") · 2026-02 · MIT, Toyota Research Institute — VLM designer, critic and orchestrator agents build simulation-ready indoor scenes from text in stages (layout, furniture, small objects), with text-to-3D and retrieved articulated assets plus estimated physical properties. ICML 2026 spotlight. [code](https://github.com/nepfaff/scenesmith) · [project](https://scenesmith.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**SAGE**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10116 "SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI") · 2026-02 · NVIDIA, UIUC, Cornell, Stanford — Given an embodied task, an agent couples layout and object generators with critics for semantics, realism and physical stability and self-refines until scenes are simulation-ready; releases the SAGE-10k interactive scene dataset. [code](https://github.com/NVlabs/sage) · [project](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/dir/sage/) · [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/SAGE-10k)
- 🟢 [**RoboCasa365**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04356 "RoboCasa365: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for Training and Benchmarking Generalist Robots") · 2026-02 · UT Austin, NVIDIA Research — Household mobile-manipulation benchmark on RoboCasa with 365 tasks, 2,500 kitchens, 600+ hours of human and 1,600+ hours of synthetic demos for multi-task, foundation-model and lifelong-learning evaluation; has a public leaderboard. ICLR 2026. _Note: v1.0 released in the RoboCasa repo in Feb 2026; arXiv version Mar 2026._ [code](https://github.com/robocasa/robocasa) · [project](https://robocasa.ai/)
- 🟢 [**mjlab**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22074 "mjlab: A Lightweight Framework for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning") · 2026-01 · UC Berkeley — Lightweight robot-learning framework that pairs Isaac Lab's manager-based environment API with MuJoCo Warp GPU physics, installs with one command, exposes native MuJoCo data structures, and ships velocity-tracking, motion-imitation and manipulation tasks. [code](https://github.com/mujocolab/mjlab) · [docs](https://mujocolab.github.io/mjlab/)
- 🟢 [**Genie Sim 3.0**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02078 "Genie Sim 3.0 : A High-Fidelity Comprehensive Simulation Platform for Humanoid Robot") · 2026-01 · AgiBot — AgiBot's open simulation platform: an LLM-powered generator builds scenes from language, 3DGS-based reconstruction adds realism, a 10,000+ hour synthetic dataset is released, and a benchmark uses LLM-generated scenarios with VLM-based auto-evaluation. _Note: The repo ships AGENTS.md and SKILL.md recipes so coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) can drive the simulator._ [code](https://github.com/AgibotTech/genie_sim) · [project](https://agibot-world.com/genie-sim)

**2025**

- 🟢 [**TongSIM**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.20206 "TongSIM: A General Platform for Simulating Intelligent Machines") · 2025-12 · BIGAI — Unreal Engine-based general-purpose platform for training and evaluating embodied agents, with 100+ multi-room indoor scenes, an open-ended outdoor town, a Python SDK and benchmarks covering perception, decision-making, human-robot cooperation and social reasoning. _Note: Per the README, indoor scenes are fully accessible while outdoor assets are being opened gradually._ [code](https://github.com/bigai-ai/tongsim) · [project](https://tongsim-platform.github.io/tongsim/) · [docs](https://bigai-ai.github.io/tongsim/)
- 🟢 [**SimWorld**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01078 "SimWorld: An Open-ended Realistic Simulator for Autonomous Agents in Physical and Social Worlds") · 2025-11 — Unreal Engine 5 simulator for building and evaluating LLM/VLM agents in open-ended physical and social settings, with language-driven procedural city generation, multimodal observations and open-vocabulary actions at several abstraction levels. _Note: Companion SimWorld-Robotics (arXiv 2512.10046, NeurIPS 2025; github.com/SCAI-JHU/SimWorld-Robotics) adds urban robot navigation and two-robot cooperative search benchmarks._ [code](https://github.com/SimWorld-AI/SimWorld) · [project](https://simworld.org/)
- 🟢 [**DISCOVERSE**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.21981 "DISCOVERSE: Efficient Robot Simulation in Complex High-Fidelity Environments") · 2025-07 · Tsinghua University et al. — Open-source Real2Sim2Real framework pairing 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering with MuJoCo physics for parallel, photorealistic multi-sensor simulation with ROS plugins; reports strong zero-shot sim-to-real for imitation learning (first-party). IROS 2025. [code](https://github.com/TATP-233/DISCOVERSE) · [project](https://air-discoverse.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**RoboTwin 2.0**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.18088 "RoboTwin 2.0: A Scalable Data Generator and Benchmark with Strong Domain Randomization for Robust Bimanual Robotic Manipulation") · 2025-06 — Bimanual data generator and benchmark with a 731-object library, MLLM-written task code refined by simulation-in-the-loop feedback, and randomization of clutter, lighting, background, table height and language; 50 tasks, five embodiments. _Note: Earlier RoboTwin (1.0) is arXiv 2504.13059 (CVPR 2025)._ [code](https://github.com/RoboTwin-Platform/RoboTwin) · [project](https://robotwin-platform.github.io/) · [docs](https://robotwin-platform.github.io/doc/)
- 🟢 [**RoboVerse**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.18904 "RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning") · 2025-04 — Unified platform, synthetic dataset and benchmarks whose MetaSim layer abstracts multiple simulators and embodiments behind one interface, enabling environment transfer and standardized imitation- and reinforcement-learning evaluation. [code](https://github.com/RoboVerseOrg/RoboVerse) · [project](https://roboverseorg.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**Newton**](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/newton-adds-contact-rich-manipulation-and-locomotion-capabilities-for-industrial-robotics) · 2025-03 · NVIDIA, Google DeepMind, Disney Research (Linux Foundation) — Open-source, GPU-accelerated, differentiable physics engine built on NVIDIA Warp and OpenUSD, with MuJoCo Warp as primary rigid-body backend plus the Kamino solver and deformable solvers; a Linux Foundation project integrated with Isaac Lab and Isaac Sim. _Note: Announced at GTC in Mar 2025 (code promised "later this year"); contributed to the Linux Foundation with a public beta in Sep 2025; 1.0 GA announced at GTC in Mar 2026 (linked blog). Kamino is described in arXiv 2603.16536._ [code](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton) · [docs](https://newton-physics.github.io/newton/)
- 🟢 [**MuJoCo Warp (MJWarp)**](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_warp) · 2025-03 · Google DeepMind, NVIDIA — GPU-optimized reimplementation of MuJoCo in NVIDIA Warp for massively parallel simulation, maintained by Google DeepMind and NVIDIA as part of Newton; alpha released March 2025 and officially released with MuJoCo 3.5.0 (Feb 2026). [docs](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mjwarp/index.html)
- 🟢 [**MuJoCo Playground**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.08844) · 2025-02 · Google DeepMind, UC Berkeley et al. — Open-source robot-learning framework on MJX bundling physics, a batch renderer and training environments for quadrupeds, humanoids, dexterous hands and arms, aimed at training in minutes on one GPU and zero-shot sim-to-real from state or pixels. [code](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_playground) · [project](https://playground.mujoco.org/)
- ⚪ [**Mega (Omniverse Blueprint)**](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/mega-omniverse-blueprint/) · 2025-01 · NVIDIA — Omniverse blueprint (reference architecture) for developing and testing fleets of mobile robots, manipulators and humanoids in industrial digital twins, with Sensor RTX simulation and software-in-the-loop testing via Isaac ROS before deployment. _Note: Announced at CES 2025 with KION and Accenture; public code availability not verified._
- 🟢 [**Isaac GR00T-Mimic Blueprint**](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/isaac-gr00t-blueprint-humanoid-robotics/ "NVIDIA Omniverse Blueprint: Synthetic Manipulation Motion Generation for Robotics") · 2025-01 · NVIDIA — Reference workflow on Omniverse, Isaac Lab and Cosmos that multiplies a few human demonstrations into large synthetic manipulation-trajectory datasets; part of the Isaac GR00T blueprint (GR00T-Teleop, -Mimic, -Gen) announced at CES 2025. _Note: Primarily a data-generation workflow; could also sit under data._ [code](https://github.com/NVIDIA-Omniverse-blueprints/synthetic-manipulation-motion-generation)

**2024**

- 🟢 [**Genesis (Genesis World)**](https://genesis-embodied-ai.github.io/) · 2024-12 · Genesis-Embodied-AI; Genesis AI — Python simulation platform that unifies rigid, FEM, MPM and particle (PBD/SPH) solvers in one scene, with photorealistic rendering and a cross-backend kernel compiler; began as an academic project in Dec 2024 and is now developed as Genesis World with Genesis AI support. _Note: The former Genesis-Embodied-AI/Genesis repo now serves the renamed genesis-world project._ [code](https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/genesis-world) · [docs](https://genesis-world.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
- 🟢 [**ManiSkill3**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.00425 "ManiSkill3: GPU Parallelized Robotics Simulation and Rendering for Generalizable Embodied AI") · 2024-10 · UC San Diego, Hillbot — Open-source GPU-parallelized simulator on SAPIEN that parallelizes physics, rendering and heterogeneous scenes, with GPU environments across 12 domains including mobile manipulation, humanoids and dexterous manipulation. [code](https://github.com/haosulab/ManiSkill) · [project](https://www.maniskill.ai/) · [docs](https://maniskill.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
- 🟢 [**GenSim2**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.03645 "GenSim2: Scaling Robot Data Generation with Multi-modal and Reasoning LLMs") · 2024-10 · Tsinghua University, UC San Diego, SJTU, MIT CSAIL — Uses multimodal and reasoning coding LLMs to create complex simulation tasks, including long-horizon tasks with articulated objects, and generates demonstrations with planning and RL solvers for up to 100 articulated tasks and 200 objects. CoRL 2024. [code](https://github.com/GenSim2/GenSim2) · [project](https://gensim2.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**InternUtopia (GRUtopia)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.10943 "GRUtopia: Dream General Robots in a City at Scale") · 2024-07 · Shanghai AI Laboratory — Isaac Sim-based simulated "3D society" for diverse robots, with GRScenes (100k interactive annotated scenes), LLM-driven NPCs (GRResidents) for social interaction and task generation, and benchmarks; renamed InternUtopia in 2025. [code](https://github.com/InternRobotics/InternUtopia) · [docs](https://internrobotics.github.io/user_guide/internutopia/)
- 🟢 [**RoboCasa**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.02523 "RoboCasa: Large-Scale Simulation of Everyday Tasks for Generalist Robots") · 2024-06 · UT Austin, NVIDIA Research — Kitchen-focused simulation framework for generalist robots with thousands of assets across 150+ categories (including text-to-3D objects and AI-generated textures) and 100 tasks, some composed with LLM guidance. RSS 2024. [code](https://github.com/robocasa/robocasa) · [project](https://robocasa.ai/)

**2023**

- 🟢 [**Holodeck**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.09067 "Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments") · 2023-12 · University of Pennsylvania, Allen Institute for AI et al. — Generates full interactive 3D environments for embodied AI from a text prompt (e.g., arcades, spas, museums), using GPT-4 for layout knowledge and spatial-relation constraints and Objaverse assets to populate scenes. CVPR 2024. [code](https://github.com/allenai/Holodeck) · [project](https://yueyang1996.github.io/holodeck/)
- 🟢 [**RoboGen**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.01455 "RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation") · 2023-11 · CMU, MIT CSAIL, UMass Amherst et al. — Generative-simulation agent with a propose-generate-learn cycle: foundation models propose skills, build matching scenes, decompose tasks, pick RL, motion planning or trajectory optimization, and generate supervision to learn them. ICML 2024. [code](https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/RoboGen) · [project](https://robogen-ai.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**MJX (MuJoCo XLA)**](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/tree/main/mjx) · 2023-10 · Google DeepMind — JAX reimplementation of MuJoCo, introduced in MuJoCo 3.0.0, that runs simulation on GPUs and TPUs for on-device reinforcement learning; a Warp backend was added in 2025 (v3.3.5) and it underpins MuJoCo Playground. - 🟢 [**Habitat 3.0**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.13724 "Habitat 3.0: A Co-Habitat for Humans, Avatars and Robots") · 2023-10 · Meta FAIR — Platform for human-robot collaboration in homes: fast humanoid-avatar simulation, human-in-the-loop tools (mouse/keyboard or VR) to evaluate robot policies with real people, and Social Navigation and Social Rearrangement tasks. _Note: Builds on Habitat (arXiv 1904.01201) and Habitat 2.0 (arXiv 2106.14405); the simulator core is github.com/facebookresearch/habitat-sim._ [code](https://github.com/facebookresearch/habitat-lab) · [project](https://aihabitat.org/habitat3/)
- 🟢 [**GenSim**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.01361 "GenSim: Generating Robotic Simulation Tasks via Large Language Models") · 2023-10 · MIT CSAIL, UC San Diego et al. — Uses an LLM's grounding and coding ability to write new simulation tasks and expert demonstrations, in goal-directed (curriculum toward a target task) and exploratory modes, to improve task-level generalization of multitask policies. [code](https://github.com/liruiw/GenSim) · [project](https://liruiw.github.io/gensim/)
- 🟢 [**Isaac Lab**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.04831 "Isaac Lab: A GPU-Accelerated Simulation Framework for Multi-Modal Robot Learning") · 2023-01 · NVIDIA — GPU-native robot-learning framework on Isaac Sim and successor to Isaac Gym, combining parallel physics, photorealistic rendering, actuator and multi-rate sensor models, data collection and domain randomization for RL and imitation learning. _Note: First released as Orbit (arXiv 2301.04195, Jan 2023) and renamed Isaac Lab in 2024; the Isaac Lab paper appeared Nov 2025. Isaac Gym is arXiv 2108.10470._ [code](https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacLab) · [docs](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/)

**2022**

- 🟢 [**ProcTHOR**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.06994 "ProcTHOR: Large-Scale Embodied AI Using Procedural Generation") · 2022-06 · Allen Institute for AI — Procedurally generates arbitrarily many interactive, AI2-THOR-compatible houses (demonstrated with 10,000) to train and evaluate embodied agents at scale on navigation, rearrangement and arm manipulation. [code](https://github.com/allenai/procthor) · [project](https://procthor.allenai.org/)

**2021**

- 🟡 [**Isaac Gym**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.10470 "Isaac Gym: High Performance GPU-Based Physics Simulation For Robot Learning") · 2021-08 · NVIDIA — GPU robot-learning platform where physics simulation and policy training both run on the GPU, passing physics buffers directly to PyTorch tensors; NVIDIA reported 2-3 orders of magnitude faster training than CPU-simulator pipelines (first-party). _Note: NVIDIA now labels Isaac Gym deprecated legacy software and recommends Isaac Lab; the simulator is a download from NVIDIA, while the IsaacGymEnvs benchmark environments are on GitHub. Date is the arXiv tech report._ [code](https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacGymEnvs) · [project](https://developer.nvidia.com/isaac-gym)
- 🟡 [**Isaac Sim**](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/announcing-general-availability-for-nvidia-isaac-sim-5-0-and-nvidia-isaac-lab-2-2/) · 2021-06 · NVIDIA — Omniverse-based robotics simulator with RTX sensor rendering, GPU physics, URDF/MJCF/CAD import, a ROS bridge and synthetic-data tools; Isaac Sim-specific extensions were open-sourced on GitHub with 5.0 (2025), while Omniverse Kit stays closed. _Note: Date is the Omniverse Isaac Sim open beta (Jun 2021); 5.0 dev preview Jun 2025, GA Aug 2025._ [code](https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacSim) · [docs](https://docs.isaacsim.omniverse.nvidia.com/latest/index.html)

**2020**

- 🟢 [**iGibson**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.02924 "iGibson 1.0: a Simulation Environment for Interactive Tasks in Large Realistic Scenes") · 2020-12 · Stanford University — Simulator of fully interactive replicas of real homes with rigid and articulated objects, virtual sensors, domain randomization, motion planners and a human interface for demonstrations; iGibson 2.0 (arXiv 2108.03272) added object-centric household-task simulation. _Note: Superseded by OmniGibson (see BEHAVIOR-1K)._ [code](https://github.com/StanfordVL/iGibson) · [project](https://svl.stanford.edu/igibson/)
- 🟢 [**robosuite**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.12293 "robosuite: A Modular Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot Learning") · 2020-09 · ARISE Initiative — Modular MuJoCo-powered simulation framework and benchmark suite for robot learning with reusable robot, controller and task modules; the arXiv report tracks the v1.5 release, which RoboCasa uses as its backend. [code](https://github.com/ARISE-Initiative/robosuite) · [project](https://robosuite.ai/)
- 🟢 [**SAPIEN**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.08515 "SAPIEN: A SimulAted Part-based Interactive ENvironment") · 2020-03 · UC San Diego et al. — Physics-rich simulated environment built around a large set of part-annotated articulated objects for part-level perception and interaction; its parallel rendering system underpins ManiSkill3. [code](https://github.com/haosulab/SAPIEN)

**2019**

- 🟢 [**Drake**](https://github.com/RobotLocomotion/drake) · 2019-09 · MIT CSAIL, Toyota Research Institute — C++/Python toolbox for analyzing robot dynamics and building controllers, emphasizing optimization-based design and exposing the structure of the governing equations (contact, gradients); started at MIT CSAIL, with core development now led by TRI. _Note: Date is the first numbered release (v0.10.0, Sep 2019)._ [docs](https://drake.mit.edu/)

**2018**

- 🟢 [**VirtualHome**](https://arxiv.org/abs/1806.07011 "VirtualHome: Simulating Household Activities via Programs") · 2018-06 — Unity-based household simulator in which agents execute activities written as programs of atomic actions and interactions; released with crowd-sourced activity programs and used to learn programs from natural language or video. CVPR 2018. [code](https://github.com/xavierpuigf/virtualhome)

**2017**

- 🟢 [**AI2-THOR**](https://arxiv.org/abs/1712.05474 "AI2-THOR: An Interactive 3D Environment for Visual AI") · 2017-12 · Allen Institute for AI — Interactive 3D environment of near photo-realistic indoor scenes where agents navigate and manipulate objects; many LLM multi-robot planners are evaluated in it (e.g., LaMMA-P's MAT-THOR, LLaMAR's MAP-THOR, Scale-Plan). [code](https://github.com/allenai/ai2thor) · [project](https://ai2thor.allenai.org/)
- 🟢 [**CARLA**](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.03938 "CARLA: An Open Urban Driving Simulator") · 2017-11 — Open-source urban driving simulator with open digital assets and configurable sensor suites and environmental conditions for developing, training and validating autonomous-driving systems. CoRL 2017. [code](https://github.com/carla-simulator/carla) · [project](https://carla.org/)
- 🟢 [**PyBullet**](https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3) · 2017-04 — Official Python interface to the Bullet Physics SDK, specialized for robotics simulation and reinforcement learning; a lightweight, pip-installable CPU simulator. _Note: Date is the first PyPI release (0.1.1, Apr 2017)._

**2012**

- 🟢 [**MuJoCo**](https://doi.org/10.1109/IROS.2012.6386109 "MuJoCo: A physics engine for model-based control") · 2012-10 · Google DeepMind — General-purpose physics engine for fast, accurate simulation of articulated bodies with contact, a default substrate for robot learning and model-based control; now maintained by Google DeepMind and fully open-source since v2.2.0 (May 2022). _Note: Date is the IROS 2012 paper (Todorov, Erez, Tassa)._ [code](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco) · [project](https://mujoco.org/) · [docs](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/)

**2004**

- 🟢 [**Gazebo**](https://doi.org/10.1109/IROS.2004.1389727 "Design and use paradigms for Gazebo, an open-source multi-robot simulator") · 2004-09 — Open-source multi-robot simulator first described at IROS 2004; today's Gazebo Sim (gz-sim) succeeds Gazebo Classic and offers high-fidelity physics, rendering and sensor models with GUI, plugin and message-passing entry points. _Note: IROS 2004 paper by Koenig and Howard; month per Semantic Scholar (IEEE Xplore online date is 2005)._ [code](https://github.com/gazebosim/gz-sim) · [project](https://gazebosim.org/)
